description.content:
Contains handlers for routes related to Appointments, Cases, Encounters etc.

  On timezones:

  Appointments are tied to Athena departments, and their date and start time are
  to be interpreted as representing a local datetime in the Athena department's
  time zone.

  Popups are special in that they have a dedicated department with the New York
  time zone, but their physical location (and thus time zone) could differ from
  that.

  To abstract over departments and popups, we introduce the notion of a location
  time zone, that is equal to the pop-up's time zone for popup appointments, and
  the department time zone for all others.

  All appointment times for appointments at physical locations are displayed to
  the user in the location time zone.

  All appointment times for virtual appointments are displayed to the user
  in their preferred time zone as communicated by the client.

Fetches a patients ongoing telehealth appointment. Ignores past ongoing
  telehealth visits and only checks the most recent visit, if the most
  recent visit is ongoing we return it.

Starts by checking for a patient's insurance. If they do not
   have any, we set their insurance as self pay. Then, we create
   an open appointment slot, book the patient into it, and check
   them into it.

Book an appointment, send the confirmation, and then build a response. If a video visit ID
  is provided, set the appointment ID for that visit in postgres.
Ask for all booked appointments for a patient.

Ask for all booked appointments for a patient and returns
   a vector of appointments and a boolean saying if the patient is established
   TDD: https://edenhealth.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PE/pages/3350986788/TDD+Filter+Appointment+Reasons+on+Patient+App+depending+on+Patient+Status+New+VS+Established+Patient

Given patient and appointment, checkout the appointment
  and send the patient a feedback survey. Always sends feedback
  even if the checkout fails.

Updates an after-visit-summary message custom type to deleted and changes content to empty string.
   If deleting message and image are successful, logs an event about the deleted message to the db.
Creates an after-visit-summary record in grdn db and sends a message in the patient's chat.
Given an existing appointment, checks the user in and assigns screeners.
Gets the screeners available for an appointment.
Fetch the booking note for an appointment.

Fetch the appointment reasons using the default provider for the provided dept.

  NOTE! As of 8/7/20, we are using a single deprecated department ('Old Mad') for all
  non-Connell locations to serve the appointment reasons. However, as we bring on departments
  offering different services, we need to move to a more department-specific model.

Requests appointments from eligible providers, filters out the immediate ones,
  and groups them based on department-id, start-time, and time-zone.
Given an encounter id, return the encounter details, including associated orders and the after visit summary.
Eden Health Inc. primary backend API service.
